items.title: The Next Fort Knox? Why the Army is Going All-In On Rare Earths
items.summary: The Army once guarded America’s gold at Fort Knox. Now it has selected REalloys for the first commercial critical-mineral processing project on a U.S. military installation—a dysprosium and terbium facility at Utah’s Tooele Army Depot.

items.title: SCCO Q2 Earnings Beat on Strong Metal Prices Despite Low Volumes
items.summary: Southern Copper beats EPS estimates as record revenues, profit and cash flow were fueled by higher metal prices, even as copper production and sales volumes declined.

items.title: COPX- A Copper ETF to Target as Wall Street Plays Catch Up
items.summary: Wall Street thought it had copper figured out. Nope! That’s why I still like the Global X Copper Miners ETF (COPX), says Sean Brodrick, editor at Weiss Rating Daily.

items.title: Freeport McMoRan (FCX) Stock May Look Reasonable Following Lower Copper Sales Outlook

items.title: Teck Resources Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Sales & Margins Improve Y/Y
items.summary: TECK crushes Q2 estimates as higher copper and zinc prices, stronger sales volumes and margin expansion drive earnings and revenues sharply higher.

items.title: FCX Q2 Earnings Call Highlights Grasberg Ramp and U.S. Growth
items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan highlights an on-schedule Grasberg ramp, stronger U.S. operations and an expanding brownfield copper pipeline.

items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan's Q2 2026 earnings show higher copper and gold prices boosting profits as its Grasberg mine ramps back up, though FCX stock dipped after a strong pre-earnings rally.
